entries.record: Single manual forecast 5 of 7 right (1 unclear).
entries.lesson: When the U.S. is actively waiving sanctions or opening trade deals with Russia, do not simultaneously predict new sanctions or continued Russian restrictions in the opposite direction. Before assuming a minor diplomatic reaction (like a statement on a neighbor's election) will appear as a headline, require at least one source to mention it; absent that, default to UNCLEAR rather than YES.
